01

“to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 9:2, 9:3).

327
Explanation from Sufyān No. 327: 1: 13

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
327: 1:13. Sufyan, on the words
"to the people on the day of the greater pilgrimage": He said, the Day of Sacrifice; "four months": he said, twenty [days] of Dhu al-Hijja, Muharram, Safar, the month of Rabi al-Awwal, and ten [days] of Rabi al-Akhir (verses 2, 3).
العربية
327: 1: 13 سفيان في قوله الناس يوم الحج الأكبر قَالَ يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ قال عشرين من ذي الحجة والمحرم وصفرا، وشهر ربيع الأول وعشرا من ربيع الآخر (الآية 3 و 2) .

06

“The polytheists are unclean, so let them not approach al-Masjid…”

An explanation transmitted from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr (Q 9:28).

332
Explanation from Saʿīd ibn Jubayr No. 332: 6: 4

Saʿīd ibn Jubayr

English
Transmission wording
332: 6:4. Sufyan, from Waqid, from Said ibn Jubayr, who said:
When there was revealed "The polytheists are unclean, so let them not approach al-Masjid al-Haram after this year of theirs," it was hard on the Muslims, and they said, "Who will bring us our food?" So God, Mighty and Majestic, revealed "and if you fear poverty, God will enrich you from His bounty" (verse 28).
العربية
332: 6: 4 سفيان عَنْ وَاقِدٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ إِنَّمَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلا يَقْرَبُوا الْمَسْجِدَ الحرام بعد عامهم هذا اشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَقَالُوا ما يأتينا بطعامنا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ اللَّهُ من فضله (الآية 28) .

09

“those who hoard gold and silver”

An explanation transmitted from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd (Q 9:34).

335
Explanation from Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd No. 335: 9: 3

Sālim ibn Abī al-Jaʿd

English
Transmission wording
335: 9:3. Sufyan, from Amr ibn Murra, from Salim ibn Abi al-Jad, who said:
When there was revealed "those who hoard gold and silver," it was hard on the Emigrants. They said, "Then what shall we keep?" Umar said, "I will spare you that." He asked the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said, "What shall we keep?" He said: "A remembering tongue, a grateful heart, and a believing wife who helps one of you in his religion" (verse 34).
العربية
335: 9: 3 سفيان عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ قَالَ لما نزلت يكنزون الذهب والفضة قَالَ اشْتَدَّ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُهَاجِرِينَ قالوا فأي شئ نَتَّخِذُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَنَا أَكْفِيكُمْ فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فقال أي شئ نتخذ قال لسان ذاكر وقلب شاكر وزوجة مؤمنة تعين أحدكم عى دينه (الآية 34) .

12

“Postponing [the sacred month] is an increase in disbelief”

Three explanations transmitted from Abu Wail and Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 9:37).

338
Explanation from Abu Wail No. 338: 12: 10

Abu Wail

English
Transmission wording
338: 12:10. Sufyan, from Mansur, from Abu Wail:
"Postponing [the sacred month] is an increase in disbelief": He said, it concerned a man of the Banu Kinana who would postpone Muharram, once making it Safar and once making it Muharram [again]. So God revealed "they make it lawful one year and forbid it another year" (verse 37).
العربية
338: 12: 10 سفيان عن منصور عن أبي وايل النسئ زيادة في الكفر قَالَ فِي رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي كنانة يؤخر المحرم مرة فيجعله صَفَرًا وَيَجْعَلُهُ مَرَّةً الْمُحَرَّمَ فَأَنْزَلَ الله عاما ويحرمونه عاما (الآية 37) .

15

“and in the cause of God and the wayfarer”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Abu Jafar (Q 9:60).

343
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 343: 17: 1

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
343: 17:1. Abu Hudhayfa related to us; Sufyan related to us, from Uthman ibn al-Aswad, from Mujahid, on the words
"and in the cause of God and the wayfarer": He said, if a calamity strikes him, or his house burns, or he goes into debt for his family, or the flood takes his wealth, he is among the debtors (verse 60).
العربية
343: 17: 1 حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حُذَيْفَةَ ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عن عثمن بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قوله وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ قَالَ إِذَا أَصَابَتْهُ مُصِيبَةٌ أَوِ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتُهُ أَوِ ادَّانَ عَلَى عياله أو اذهب السَّيْلُ بِمَالِهِ فَهُوَ مِنَ الْغَارِمِينَ (الآية 60) .
Edition record 371366 · p. 127Link to report ↗
344
Explanation from Abu Jafar No. 344: 18: 7

Abu Jafar

English
Transmission wording
344: 18:7. Sufyan, from Jabir, from Abu Jafar, on the words of God
"and the debtors, and in the cause of God, and the wayfarer": He said, the debtors are those who took on debt without corruption, and the wayfarer is one passing from land to land (verse 60).

344: 18: 7 سفيان عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ وَالْغَارِمِينَ وَفِي سبيل الله وابن السبيل قَالَ الْغَارِمِينَ الْمُسْتَدِينِينَ بِغَيْرِ فَسَادٍ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ الْمُجْتَازِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ الى الأرض (الآية 60) .

16

Verse 114

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 9:114).

345
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 345: 19: 2

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
345: 19:2. Sufyan, from Habib ibn Abi Thabit, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said:
Abraham kept asking forgiveness for his father until he died. When he died, it became clear to him that he was an enemy of God, so he disassociated himself from him (verse 114).
العربية
345: 19: 2 سفيان عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ بن عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ مَا زَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِأَبِيهِ حَتَّى مَاتَ فَلَمَّا مَاتَ تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ أَنَّهُ عَدُوٌّ لله فتبرأ منه (الآية 114) .
